limitations: Original SRAM diagnostic is loaded by the unmodified mask ROM as a diagnostic bootloader; this is not a manufacturer image, SDK startup or factory compatibility claim.
Host PPM pixels are sensor input; every acceptance decision follows guest SCCB/LEDC/GPIO/I2S/native DMA memory operations. No host-painted camera framebuffer is accepted as execution.
W5500 test uses actual guest SPI Socket0 MACRAW and the independent local wired VirtualNet peer; TCP/UDP hardwired socket offload, physical PHY/PoE/FCS and internet reachability are not validated.
Node uses the production runtime/Worker/WASM path without browser GPU rendering or physical hardware. Camera optics, ISP, JPEG encoder and analog/battery/RTC behavior are excluded.
